message: an ICU's case draws a tag at offset 716 (`none}`), and the tag scan never found it
$reason: `stop-in-an-icu-behind-a-quoted-name` in both cases of one ICU: a stop behind `[it's]` in the first and one behind `[a"b]` in the second, so that neither quote closes the other's. The tag scan finds neither, and the HTML tree places both (`cased`). The refusal quotes the first, the `=0` case's, by its offset and the line it opens: each case before this one drew one such tag, so a refusal that quoted the last of them passed them all.
